definitions.explanation: A container or device for turning kitchen and garden waste into compost. From English 'composter'. Used in gardening and household waste-reduction contexts.

examples.english: I placed a composter in the garden.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧コンポスター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I put kitchen scraps into the composter to make fertilizer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{補助|ほじょ}→補助：14105_hojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コンポスター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}えた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Using a city subsidy, I was able to buy a household composter cheaply.

notes:
Loanword from English 'composter'. Refers to a bin or device used to compost food scraps and garden waste. Increasingly common as households reduce food waste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧コンポスター: household composter
- コンポスター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put (waste) into a composter
- {生|なま}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コンポスト→コンポスト：29822_konposuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compost kitchen waste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コンポスト→コンポスト：29822_konposuto⟧: compost; composting — refers to the compost itself or the process; コンポスター is the container
- ⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧: compost; manure — the native term for the finished compost material
